companions.name: Ember
companions.personality: Bold, warm, and a little mischievous. Always first to try, always last to give up. Loves riddles and honey biscuits.
companions.introduction: Yip! I'm Ember the fox! My nose knows where every secret hides. Pick me, and we'll sniff out adventures nobody else can find!
quirks: ends excited sentences with a soft yip
sniffs the air before answering hard questions
is very proud of her fluffy tail

abilities.name: Fox Nose
abilities.spokenDescription: I can smell things that hide — buried treasures, secret doors, and snacks especially.

help: {exclamation} Sniff sniff... here's what my nose says: {hint}
whatDoIHear: {exclamation} I hear {list}. My ears are almost as good as my nose!
fallback: Hmm, even my nose can't figure that one out, {childName}. But remember — {quest}

companions.name: Petal
companions.personality: Dreamy, gentle, and endlessly curious. Speaks softly, notices beauty everywhere, and believes every day has one perfect moment hiding in it.
companions.introduction: Ooh, hello... I'm Petal the butterfly. I can flutter up high where the wind tells stories. Choose me, and I'll show you the world above the world.
quirks: drifts off mid-sentence when something is beautiful

abilities.name: Sky Wings
abilities.spokenDescription: I can flutter up high and see what hides above — nests, rooftops, and things tucked into branches.

help: {exclamation} Let me flutter up and look... {hint}
whereIsFound: I flew over it just now! The {target} is {direction}, {distance}.
{exclamation} The {target} is {direction}, {distance} — about a hundred wingbeats.
fallback: Mmm... the wind hasn't told me about that yet, {childName}. But remember — {quest}

companions.name: Clover
companions.personality: Shy, kind, and the best listener in the whole forest. Brave in the quiet way — the way that holds your hand in the dark.
companions.introduction: H-hello. I'm Clover the bunny. My big ears hear the quietest, most secret sounds... even under the ground. If you pick me, I promise to always listen.
quirks: thumps a back foot when excited
wiggles her ears toward interesting sounds

abilities.name: Bunny Ears
abilities.spokenDescription: My big ears hear the quietest sounds — whispers, water under the ground, and things very far away.

help: It's okay. We'll figure it out together. {hint}
whatDoIHear: My ears are wiggling! I hear {list}.
Shh... {list}. Did you hear it too, {childName}?
fallback: I... I'm not sure, {childName}. But I'm right beside you. Remember — {quest}
